vehicles.name: Booster 22
vehicles.avid_graphic_note: AVID graphic: cryo 2×, SF 0× (stale — one 33-engine SF confirmed 25 Oct).
vehicles.latest_note: Flew Flight 15 (13 Nov 2026). Ascent and hot-staging succeeded. Boostback ended early due to low fuel mass (root cause under investigation). Guidance aborted the tower catch and diverted the booster offshore. It executed a landing burn, hovered over the Gulf, and the flight termination system was triggered at landing-burn shutdown. SpaceX said recovery and environmental teams were on site after splashdown.
